name: Bedmi Poori & Nagori Halwa
instructions: 1. Soak urad dal, grind coarsely, and sauté with spices like hing and fennel to make the stuffing.
2. Mix whole wheat flour with a little oil and salt to knead a firm dough; stuff the dal mixture into small dough balls.
3. Roll out the stuffed dough into thick discs and deep-fry until golden and crispy.
4. Prepare the Nagori by kneading a stiff dough of sooji and flour, rolling small discs, and frying them until crunchy.
5. Prepare the Halwa by roasting sooji in ghee, adding sugar syrup and dry fruits.
6. Serve the hot Bedmi poori with a spicy aloo tamatar curry and the crunchy Nagori with the sweet halwa.
description: Bedmi Poori and Nagori Halwa is a legendary breakfast staple from Old Delhi. The contrast between the savory, spicy, lentil-stuffed pooris and the sweet, crunchy Nagori halwa represents the rich, indulgent culinary heritage of Delhi street food culture.
